title: Segfault when executing fp8 matmul on fully dynamic shapes
body:
### What happened?

Execution of dynamic shape matmul leads to this following error at runtime:  

```
iree/runtime/src/iree/hal/drivers/hip/event_semaphore.c:787: ABORTED; the semaphore was aborted; while invoking native function hal.fence.await; while calling import; 
[ 0] bytecode module.matmul:742 matmul.mlir:9:13
      at matmul.mlir:1:1
```

Only seen with tensor<?x?xf8E4M3FNUZ> x tensor<?x?xf8E4M3FNUZ>

### Steps to reproduce your issue

Use this IR : 
```
util.func @matmul(%lhs: tensor<?x?xf8E4M3FNUZ>, %rhs: tensor<?x?xf8E4M3FNUZ>) -> tensor<?x?xf32> {
  %c0 = arith.constant 0 : index
  %c1 = arith.constant 1 : index
  %acc_dim0 = tensor.dim %lhs, %c0 : tensor<?x?xf8E4M3FNUZ>
  %acc_dim1 = tensor.dim %rhs, %c1 : tensor<?x?xf8E4M3FNUZ>
  %init_acc = tensor.empty(%acc_dim0, %acc_dim1) : tensor<?x?xf32>
  %c0_acc_type = arith.constant 0.0: f32
  %acc = linalg.fill ins(%c0_acc_type : f32) outs(%init_acc : tensor<?x?xf32>) -> tensor<?x?xf32>
  %result = linalg.matmul   ins(%lhs, %rhs: tensor<?x?xf8E4M3FNUZ>, tensor<?x?xf8E4M3FNUZ>) outs(%acc: tensor<?x?xf32>) -> tensor<?x?xf32>
  util.return %result: tensor<?x?xf32>
}
```

Compile command: 

```
iree-compile matmul.mlir --iree-hip-target=gfx942 --iree-hal-target-backends=rocm --iree-hip-enable-tensor-ukernels --iree-opt-level=O3 -o tmp/dispatch.vmfb
```

Run command:
```
iree-benchmark-module --benchmark_min_warmup_time=0.1 --benchmark_repetitions=5 --batch_size=1 --
benchmark_min_time=0.1s --device=hip:1 --device_allocator=caching --module=tmp/dispatch.vmfb --function=matmul --input=2048x2048xf8E4M3FNUZ --input=2048x2048xf8E4M3FNUZ
```
